notes.title: Blacksea Odyssey Version 1.2 Released!
notes.notes:
Ahoy, space-huntsman! Thanks for everyone's feedback and bug reports - they have been a HUGE help!  We fixed a ton of issues that players were having and also added in some new features. 

Blacksea Odyssey v1.2

Features

Added Water Spear Rune 1,2,3, and 4 
Added Legendary Spear Rune Ellery Spear (Named after one of our biggest fans)
Added Taco Bomb
Added Tacopocalypse (Named after our friends game Tacopocalypse)
Added a remove screenshake option
Added a custom controller option (for people that want to use their own controller input)


Bug Fixes

Fixed a bug that was causing the game to crash while fighting the leviathan.
Fixed a bug that was causing the game to crash post round 5.
Fixed a bug that was causing the game to lag post round 4.
Fixed a bug that was causing audio to leak from round to round.
Fixed a bug that was causing puffers to disspear.
Fixed a bug that was causing an issue with saving/loading.


Balancing

Increased rades damage passive from 10% to 20%.
Increased Coupe De Graces critical damage from 1000% to 1500%.
Increased one eighty shot spear damage by 5, 10, 15, and 20.
Enemies have a higher quality rune drop chance in later stages of the game.
Chests have a higher quality rune drop chance in later stages of the game.
Chests have a higher chance to drop runes.
Chests drop more credits.
Shop has a higher chance to hold runes.
Shop has a higher chance to hold higher quality runes.
Shop has a GREATLY higher chance to drop epics/legendaries late game.


If you have any bug send an email to TeamBlackseaOdyssey@gmail.com and also send us this file when the bug occurs.

C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\BlackseaOdyssey\BlackseaOdyssey_Data\output_log.txt

Thanks again and enjoy! :D

- Team Blacksea Odyssey

notes.title: Blacksea Odyssey v0.5.7 [hotfix] Released!
notes.notes:
Ahoy, space-huntsman! We noticed that the Bestiary broke the Tutorial, so we wanted to upload a hotfix that fixed that! We also fixed a few other minor bugs while we were at it. :)

Blacksea Odyssey v0.5.7 [hotfix]

Bugs Fixed
Fixed black rectangle covering Tutorial sceneFixed green arrow indicator pointing to odd positions in Tutorial sceneFixed "Goob Job!" Tutorial text occasionally getting suck fading in out out very quicklyFixed not being able to click certain parts of Bounty Displays in the Bount Select screenFixed Charybdis's animation not working for Boss Previews in the Bounty Select screen
Don't worry if a bug you reported recently wasn't fixed in this hotfix. We added them to our bug list and will get to them soon.

Thanks so much for the reports - keep 'em coming!

- Team Blacksea Odyssey

notes.title: Blacksea Odyssey v0.5.2 [hotfix] Released!
notes.notes:
Ahoy, space-huntsman! We decided to upload a hotfix to patch up some of bugs we discovered in v0.5.1! Sorry about these, but thanks to you we were able to resolve them quickly. :)

Blacksea Odyssey v0.5.2 [hotfix]

Bugs Fixed
Fixed Rade's health going higher than max health bugFixed mouse being stuck in artifical boundary bugFixed harpoon collision not working occasionallyFixed auto-fullscreen bug (for real this time!)Fixed saving/loading bug that started the game in later roundsFixed game not loading bounties from save file on round 5
Don't worry if a bug you reported recently wasn't fixed in this hotfix. We added them to our bug list and will get to them soon. We just wanted to fix these more serious ones immediately.

Thanks so much for the reports - keep 'em coming!

- Team Blacksea Odyssey
